label: Lesson 141–142
titleCn: 莎莉第一次乘火车旅行

lines.cn: 莎莉的第一次火车旅行

lines.en: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.cn: 请听录音，然后回答这个问题：
为什么那位母亲感到尴尬？

lines.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
lines.cn: 上周，我四岁的女儿莎莉被邀请参加一个儿童派对。

lines.en: I decided to take her by train.
lines.cn: 上周，我四岁的女儿莎莉被邀请参加一个儿童派对。我决定带她坐火车去。

lines.en: Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
lines.cn: 莎莉非常兴奋，因为她以前从未坐过火车。

lines.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
lines.cn: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切都充满了好奇，不停地提问。

lines.en: Suddenly, a middle-age lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
lines.cn: 突然，一位中年女士上了火车，坐在莎莉的对面。

lines.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
lines.cn: 莎莉没有回答，只是好奇地盯着她看。

lines.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
lines.cn: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又有趣的帽子。

lines.en: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
lines.cn: 火车离开车站后，那位女士打开她的手提包，拿出了她的粉饼。

lines.en: She then began to make up her face.
'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
lines.cn: “你为什么要那么做？”莎莉问道。

lines.en: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
lines.cn: “为了让自己变得更美丽，”那位女士回答道。

lines.en: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
lines.cn: 她收起了她的相机，然后露出了友善的微笑。

lines.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
lines.cn: 莎莉觉得这很有趣，但我却感到非常尴尬！
